name: Intake Desk
tagline: One prioritized queue for every inbound request, lead and job, each with a next step
description: Solo operators get pulled apart by requests arriving from five directions at once. Paste them here - leads, jobs, favors, whatever came in - and you get one sorted queue, ranked, with a single sensible next step attached to every item. The point is not elaborate workflow; it is knowing what to touch first.
author: AMFoxtrot
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
